principles: Official existence does not imply feature admission or predictive importance.
Historical event-format documents are not current generic rules unless corroborated.
Human forecast information is not objective race-generation truth.

verified_reality.claim: Competition is governed by formal judging criteria for interference and unsafe conduct, including pressure/pushing, inside/outer-band positioning, middle-splitting, and exemptions.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Judging PDF pp.73-80 and pp.119-123 sections; violation outcomes include disqualification, major riding caution and riding caution depending rule/degree.

verified_reality.claim: Middle-splitting is formally defined as inserting/passing between two riders without sufficient safe interval and can lead to DQ or major caution depending impact/phase.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Judging PDF p.79 and related current criteria.

verified_reality.claim: Pressure/pushing is formally defined and judged by resulting interference, degree and race phase; explicit exemption grounds exist.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Judging PDF pp.75-77 and current parallel criteria; exemption section explicitly labelled 免責事由.

verified_reality.claim: Track-line concepts such as inner line, outer band line and yellow line are formal judging/track entities.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Judging PDF pp.73-74 and track-line appendix around pp.137-138.

verified_reality.claim: Pacer/lead rider is a formal race actor in lead-fixed racing and judging/operations include it explicitly.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation rule Arts.13, 17-23; judging role/track sections.

unresolved: Exact current primary wording for generic 敢闘義務 was not isolated in this audit.
Exact current primary handling under the label 周回誤認 was not isolated; do not substitute historical explanations.

verified_reality.claim: Race composition is not generated as an IID random sample of riders.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Program formation PDF p.5: riders are allocated across races considering ability, riding style, regional balance and other factors; rider numbers consider ability/style/results.

verified_reality.claim: Program officials explicitly examine rider ability, style, technical skill, recent competition results and other information before formation.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: PDF pp.4-5: advance assessment and program-card fields include class, age, registered prefecture, bicycle, gear ratio, recent average competition score and recent results.

verified_reality.claim: Day-2-and-later progression is path-dependent on prior-day finish and event advancement rules.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: PDF pp.6-7: advancing riders are determined using the day's finish; tie/equal-position/abandonment/race-not-established cases have further rules.

verified_reality.claim: Replacement/substitution is a formal process before and during a meeting.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: PDF pp.4-6: pre-meeting non-participation replacement, pre-inspection-day replacement, mid-meeting replacement.

verified_reality.claim: Weather or other cancellation can trigger explicit reprogramming and can affect whether already-run finishes count for subsequent advancement.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Current program PDF p.6 gives reprogramming rule for cancellation before race 5 start; 2005 Q&A is preserved only as event-specific historical detail.

verified_reality.claim: Field size is formally constrained/determined per meeting and track width rather than universally fixed.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation rule Art.35.

verified_reality.claim: Official/public pre-race rider descriptors include registered prefecture, style, class, graduation term and age.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: KEIRIN.JP racecard guide and rider-search filters.

verified_reality.claim: Public competition score is an official racecard strength summary based on the recent four months.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Racecard guide section 競走得点.

verified_reality.claim: Program operations maintain additional pre-race context such as recent results, bicycle name and gear ratio.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Program formation PDF pp.4-6.

verified_reality.claim: KEIRIN.JP rider search exposes home bank/home velodrome as searchable attributes.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Search page rider filters.

unresolved: Exact public competition_score formula/version governance was not mapped one-to-one to the JKA regulatory evaluation-point formula in this audit.
Historical machine-readable completeness and point-in-time availability of home bank are not yet verified.

verified_reality.claim: Track circumference differs materially across venues and current official values are published.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Current bank-record table includes 333/335/400/500m examples and record metadata.

verified_reality.claim: Track geometry and facility structure are regulated/approved physical properties, and changes require formal reporting.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Enforcement rule Arts.8 and 13 require structure/equipment plans and change reporting.

partial_or_unresolved: A current, nationwide, machine-readable official registry for straight length, maximum cant and detailed geometry was not verified; old official venue pages may contain historical values but are not promoted to current truth.
Indoor/outdoor/roof/environment classification needs venue-by-venue current official confirmation.

verified_reality.claim: A rider must use a JKA-registered bicycle and the bicycle is subject to formal inspection.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation rule Art.32 and Arts.40-42; safety-standard context.

verified_reality.claim: Bicycle name and gear ratio are operational pre-race data and can be updated/changed before racing.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Program PDF pp.5-6 records bicycle name/gear ratio and records changes reported by inspection officials.

verified_reality.claim: KEIRIN.JP data room maintains official indexes for registered bicycle and certified-parts information, but detailed iframe bodies were not obtained in this audit.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Data-room link descriptions only.

verified_reality.claim: JMA official observations can supply precipitation, temperature, humidity and wind with station-dependent coverage.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: JMA observation-site data-element table.

verified_reality.claim: Historical JMA values can be revised after publication.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Download-service warning that historical data may later be corrected.

F_ENVIRONMENT.point_in_time_rule: For a model feature, use only an observation/version provably available before prediction timestamp; separately freeze venue-to-station mapping and missingness/publication-lag policy.
unresolved: Publication-lag semantics for each observation product were not frozen here.

verified_reality.claim: Entrant membership is stateful: eligibility confirmation, health suitability and bicycle inspection can prevent participation.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation rule Arts.40-42.

verified_reality.claim: Participation can be stopped/cancelled after initial program formation; relevant officials are notified.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation rule Arts.18 and 42-46 context.

verified_reality.claim: Finish order and winner determination are official judging acts; final judging includes photo-finish personnel.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation Arts.20-23; judging PDF final-judge/photo sections.

verified_reality.claim: Ties are legitimate result states rather than parser errors in reality.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation Art.36(3) prize split for ties; program PDF gives advancement handling for ties.

verified_reality.claim: DQ, abandonment and race-not-established states participate in downstream program logic.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Judging criteria and program PDF pp.6-7.

verified_reality.claim: Japanese law distinguishes voting-system categories and defines the winning positions/combinations by system.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Law Art.11; enforcement rule Arts.19-20.

verified_reality.claim: If entrants disappear to zero/one, a race is not established, or there is no winner, votes can be legally invalidated; non-starters also trigger invalidation rules depending voting type.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Law Art.14.

verified_reality.claim: Payout and refund are separate operational responsibilities from sporting outcome generation.
verified_reality.exact_evidence: Implementation Art.25; enforcement rule payout provisions.
